name: Story Mapper
tagline: Turns your app's code and real screenshots into a user story map: a one-pager, an architecture diagram by topic and a clickable viewer.
description: Turns your app's code and real screenshots into a user story map: a one-pager, an architecture diagram by topic and a clickable viewer. For solo developers and small teams who want to see which stories exist, how they connect and which are missing.
